title: The Gap Into Conflict: The Real Story
author: Donaldson, Stephen R.

highlights.text: Apparently, one out of every hundred people had some kind of undetectable vulnerability in the tissue of the brain; and when that vulnerability was translated across light-years of space through the imponderable physics of the gap, something happened to it. Otherwise healthy individuals lost command of their lives in invariably startling, often grotesque, and sometimes murderous fashions.
The main thrust of the action was clear enough. Details that didn’t make sense could eventually be forgotten. The crowd at Mallorys would have found the real story much harder to live with.
his need for money had limits while his desire to see what matter cannon fire could do was immense.
He may not have been rich, but he was probably everything else the people in Mallorys believed him to be. He was also a coward.
he would be sneered at everywhere in DelSec; but he could live with that. The world had been sneering at him from the first. He took revenge when he got the chance.
“I don’t care if you come from fucking God. You can’t have my ship.”

For that reason, he pushed the button which took away her ability to move. Then he put down the control and beat her bloody with his bare fists, marring her beauty so that it wouldn’t terrify him anymore.
He’d never had much to do with women. In the course of his piracies, he’d captured or kidnapped a few, used them hard, then gotten rid of them.
“No,” he rasped. “I’m never going to stop. I’m never going to stop hurting you. You’re too frightened. That’s what I like.”
Angus Thermopyle was a coward: he was at his best when he was afraid.
But his ideas of love only made her giggle in scorn. Her knife told him what she thought of having him in her bed. When she left, there were tears streaming through the blood into his mouth.

He was perfectly willing to defile and humiliate every inch of her to take the sting out of his heart. His stomach was a knot of black hate, and his brain was so full of violence he could hardly keep his balance.
“You bastard,” Angus muttered through his teeth. “You shit-eating bastard. I’m going to rip your balls off.” It was just a question of when and where.
Come on, you shithead motherfucking cocksuckers.
